objective: Action allocate: weights is a list of nonnegative integers, seats an integer 0..1000. Allocate seats proportionally using largest remainders: floor each exact quota, then distribute remaining seats in descending fractional remainder, breaking ties by lower index. Empty weights returns [] only when seats=0; positive seats with zero total weight raises ValueError. Zero seats always returns one zero per weight. Implement in domain.py and route through api.dispatch(payload) and python cli.py (one JSON input on stdin, one JSON result on stdout). Preserve existing identity action for any JSON value, unknown-action ValueError, successful JSON CLI behavior, and CLI exit 2 with nonempty stderr without traceback on ValueError. Never mutate input, including on failure: operations are atomic from the caller perspective. Standard library, Python 3.12+, UTF-8. Types/shapes/bounds are guaranteed except explicitly specified validation errors; do not invent validation. Add at least three meaningful unittest test methods discoverable with python -m unittest discover, covering normal, boundary and relevant rejected inputs (or a second boundary if no rejection is specified). Tests must pass and test public behavior. Expand README.md with new action usage, an executable CLI example, and boundary/error semantics (at least 40 words in the complete README). Preserve all public interfaces; helpers are allowed.
